- **Formatting only:** the diff across `src/main.rs`, `src/location.rs` and `src/solar.rs` is line wrapping, import order and one added blank line. I found no token changes.
- **Checks:** `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes, `cargo test --locked` passes (46 passed, 1 ignored), and `cargo clippy --all-targets` reports no warnings.
